title: Chinless Chinaman! Chin Chon Eg Lin Ton
html_source:
Racism from Mulligan, probably citing to the operetta The Geisha (1896), which contains a song with the deplorable title “Chin Chin Chinaman”
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Geisha

Mulligan is punning John Eglinton’s name. Portraits of McGee depict (to me) a man with an ordinary chin. The allusion and the bridge to a pun seem to allure Mulligan more than any attempt to describe McGee.
